areas.name: Arithmetic & Number

topics.name: Integers & Number Properties
topics.description: Odd and even, primes, factors, multiples, divisibility, remainders and digits.

topics.name: Fractions & Decimals
topics.description: Operations with fractions and decimals, comparing and ordering numbers.

topics.name: Percents
topics.description: Percent of a quantity, percent change, discounts and interest.

topics.name: Ratios, Proportions & Rates
topics.description: Ratios, direct proportion, unit rates, speed and work.

topics.name: Exponents & Roots
topics.description: Powers, square roots, scientific notation and the laws of exponents.

topics.name: Averages
topics.description: Arithmetic mean, weighted averages and sums from averages.

areas.name: Algebra
areas.description: Expressions, equations, inequalities, defined symbols and word problems.

topics.name: Expressions & Factoring
topics.description: Simplifying, evaluating, expanding and factoring algebraic expressions.

topics.name: Equations & Systems
topics.description: Linear equations, systems of equations and solving for one variable in terms of another.

topics.name: Inequalities & Absolute Value
topics.description: Solving and reasoning with inequalities, ranges and absolute value.

topics.name: Defined Operations & Symbols

topics.name: Word Problems
topics.description: Translating a verbal situation into arithmetic or an equation.

areas.name: Geometry
areas.description: Lines, angles, triangles, circles, area, volume and coordinates.

topics.name: Circles

topics.name: Solids & Volume

topics.name: Coordinate Geometry
topics.description: Points, distances, slopes and figures in the coordinate plane.

topics.name: Counting & Probability

topics.name: Tables & Graphs
topics.description: Reading and interpreting tables, charts and graphs.
